visual_anchor: Foreground white-flower/plant and dry-stem patch; analysis ROI x=[560,980), y=[300,500) in 980x552 frames. This ROI contains both vegetation and some flow pixels; robust consensus inliers are the static-looking visual features, but individual plant/leaf motion is not separable from camera motion here.
method: OpenCV 5.0.0 ORB (1500 features, 1.2 scale factor, 8 levels, edgeThreshold 10, patchSize 31, fastThreshold 6); BFMatcher Hamming, Lowe ratio <0.8; partial affine transform estimated by RANSAC (2.5 px reprojection threshold, 5000 iterations, confidence 0.995). Values describe relative image-plane registration of the selected ROI, not physical camera motion.
interpretation: The tracked ROI shows nearly unchanged local scale (0.99947-1.00034) but nonzero shifts: about +12.44 px x from 26 to 52 s, +3.46 px x/-2 px y from 52 to 78 s, and +3 px x/-13 px y from 78 to 104 s. These shifts may reflect camera movement/reframing, local vegetation motion, or both. The analysis cannot establish that the source is a continuous fixed-camera shot and cannot conclusively rule out edits elsewhere in the clip.
limits: Only these four sparse frames were compared. No new decoding, whole-clip review, or raw-media modification was done. Do not state 'no pan/zoom' or 'single uninterrupted fixed camera' based on this evidence.
